gate_rule: Pass requires higher median test Sharpe, higher benchmark-excess Sharpe and return, no material drawdown deterioration, effect beyond turnover reduction, cross-fold/seed support, and separation from reverse negative controls.
rationale: No non-reverse G1 variant simultaneously improved central frozen-test and benchmark-relative OOS metrics. The best variant improved benchmark-excess return but worsened test Sharpe and benchmark-excess Sharpe.
g2_implication: Run G2 independently against base_macro. Do not include G1 in G3 unless G2 passes and g1h is used only as an exploratory combination.
final_recommendation: Close G1 as fail and continue with G2 conservative action regularization screening.
